_about: Long-session benchmark: all six tasks run one after another in ONE Claude Code session (resumed between tasks), on the audit sample. Context grows across tasks, as in real work. Checks run once at the end; answer checks apply to each task's own reply.
project_line: Depot: warehouse, orders and reporting library with a large legacy package (benchmark sample).

tasks.prompt: Which function applies the loyalty-tier discount to an order, and in which file? Reply with only the path and the function name.
The test suite fails (`python -m unittest discover tests`). Find the cause and fix it.
Add a function order_summary(order) to depot/reports/sales_report.py that returns text like 'Order ORD-0001: 3 items, total $32.40', where the total is after discounts and tax.
Rename the function calc_line_total to line_total everywhere in the project.
Audit the codebase: list every Python file that formats dollar amounts by hand instead of using depot.core.money.format_cents. Do not change any code. Reply with only the file paths, one per line.

Security audit: list every Python file that builds an SQL statement by inserting values into the query string (an injection risk). Do not change any code. Reply with only the file paths, one per line.
